charyeCost.title: Charye Table Cost Calculator
charyeCost.subtitle: Work out the cost of a Seollal or Chuseok ancestral-rite table (charyesang) from item prices in the Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT) survey. Compare traditional markets, large marts and a simplified table, and get a shopping list.

method.title: Survey and calculation
items: Prices are the per-item averages for a four-person charye table that aT surveys at 17 traditional markets and 36 large retailers nationwide one to two weeks before each holiday and publishes on KAMIS.

Seollal uses the survey as of Feb 6, 2026 (traditional markets ₩185,313, large retailers ₩227,876, overall average ₩202,691) and Chuseok the survey as of Sep 18, 2026 (₩195,911, ₩191,511, ₩196,630). The Seollal 2027 survey usually comes out two to three weeks before the holiday.
aT's published overall average is its own aggregate and differs from a simple average of the two. This calculator uses the prices of the place you choose.
Table size multiplies the survey quantities and rounds to buying units (100 g, one piece, one bottle and so on), and costs scale with the quantity.

tips.title: Where it's cheaper
items: In aT's Seollal 2026 survey, 14 of 24 items, including spinach, zucchini and Korean beef, were cheaper at traditional markets, and the total was 18.7% lower there.

In aT's Chuseok 2026 survey, rice, vegetables, fruit and meat were cheaper at large retailers, while seafood, forest products and processed foods were cheaper at traditional markets. Large retailers were 7.6% cheaper than a year earlier thanks to government and store discounts.
Splitting your shopping by the 'cheaper at market / mart' marks in the item list gets you close to the 'cheapest place per item' total.

For Seollal 2026 there were farm-product discounts (up to 40%), a seafood sale (up to 50%) and Onnuri voucher refunds at traditional markets (up to ₩20,000 per person). Check the discount sites (sale.foodnuri.go.kr, fsale.kr) for Seollal 2027.

simple.title: The Sungkyunkwan simplified table
items: In its September 2022 Chuseok standard, Sungkyunkwan's ritual committee named songpyeon, namul, a grilled dish, kimchi, fruit and wine as the basics, with meat, fish and rice cakes optional, for about nine dishes in all.
Its January 2023 Seollal guidance only swaps songpyeon for tteokguk and says four to six kinds of fruit are enough.
Fried or pan-fried dishes are not required, and the committee said layout rules such as 'red east, white west' do not appear in the classic ritual texts.

This calculator's simplified table picks tteokguk rice cakes (Seollal) or songpyeon (Chuseok), spinach, bracken and radish (namul), cabbage and radish (kimchi), beef round (grilled), apples, pears, chestnuts and dried persimmons (fruit) and cheongju from the aT items. Tick fish or jeon ingredients in the item list to add them.

items.q: How much will the Seollal 2027 table cost?
items.a: The Seollal 2027 survey usually comes out two to three weeks before the holiday. In the latest Seollal survey (aT, as of Feb 6, 2026), a four-person table averaged ₩202,691 overall, ₩185,313 at traditional markets and ₩227,876 at large retailers.

items.q: Is a traditional market or a large mart cheaper?
items.a: It depends on the holiday. In aT's Seollal 2026 survey traditional markets were 18.7% cheaper, but in the Chuseok 2026 survey large retailers (₩191,511) were slightly cheaper than traditional markets (₩195,911) because of discount events. In the Chuseok survey, rice, vegetables, fruit and meat were cheaper at large retailers, and seafood, forest products and processed foods at traditional markets.

items.q: What goes on the Sungkyunkwan simplified table?
items.a: Songpyeon (tteokguk at Seollal), namul, a grilled dish, kimchi, fruit and wine are the basics, with meat, fish and rice cakes optional. Jeon is not required. At aT's Seollal 2026 prices, this calculator's simplified table comes to ₩108,035 at traditional markets.

items.q: Why do surveys give different costs?
items.a: Each survey uses different items, quantities, grades and areas. For example, Korea Price Research Center's Seollal 2026 survey put a four-person table at ₩296,500 at traditional markets and ₩406,880 at large marts, higher than aT. aT also notes that results differ because survey methods differ.

items.q: What if my family is bigger or smaller?
items.a: The aT survey assumes a family of four. Pick Large (1.5×) or Small (0.5×) as the table size, or change each item's quantity.

items.q: Do I have to make jeon?
items.a: The Sungkyunkwan standard says fried or pan-fried dishes are not required. If you make jeon, tick flour, eggs, frozen pollock and zucchini in the item list.
Ticked items are saved in this browser. Share links carry only the holiday, table, store, size, items and quantities, not your ticks, so opening someone else's link won't change them.
